title: Opti Create ModPack
description: The best way to play Create Mod with dignity.
body:
## ⚙️ OPTI CREATE!

### 🛠️ Create Mod add-ons included:

- Create Aeronautics
- Create Jetpack
- Create More Automation
- Create More Conveyor
- Create More: Vertical Belts
- Create: Bits ‘n’ Bobs
- Create: Connected
- Create: Copper & Zinc
- Create: Diesel Generators
- Create Enchantable Machinery
- Create: Liquid Fuel
- Create: Ultimate Factory
- Create Better FPS

### **📈 Optimization Results (On Older PCs)**

The results of the modpack optimization are incredible. Here you can see the actual comparison running on a 2011 graphics card:

**❌ Before Optimization (Minecraft With Create and addons)**

40-50 FPS (GPU: GT440)

**🟢 After Optimization (Opti Create)**

100-120 FPS (GPU: GT440)

### **⚠️ Important Notices**

**> 📌 Notice 1**

This is the first version of the modpack; all positive feedback is welcome!

**> 📌 Notice 2**

If the arms don’t load when you start a world, press F11. That will fix the problem!

**> 📌 Notice 3**

Go to the Video Settings section, then Fps Reducer, and under Performance, change Chunks Update Threads to match your processor’s threads to improve performance.
